long_biography.plain_text:
Becoming a gynaecologist fulfilled an ambition Gulbakhor Burkhanovna Ismailova had held since childhood. Strong school results led to Tashkent Medical Institute, where she graduated with honours before spending her career in medicine. She later retired after a working life devoted to the speciality.

A family succession plan also named Ismailova as a beneficiary of trusts. She said the arrangement reflected her childless brother's wish to share his estate among relatives. Ismailova later executed deeds permanently excluding her from future benefits; the trusts' lawyer stated that the declaration could not be revoked or annulled.
